name: [Master][Izin][AUTH-01] A deactivated user cannot sign in
description: Turning a user inactive must block their next login.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open user management (Staf & Kasir) and create a cashier user named 'UJI Nonaktif' with email uji.nonaktif@majubersama.online and password UjiNonaktif123 in branch OFFICE MAJU BERSAMA
Edit the user 'UJI Nonaktif', turn it inactive, and save
Sign out
Sign in with email uji.nonaktif@majubersama.online and password UjiNonaktif123
Verify the login is refused with a message that the account is inactive, and the cashier screen is not shown

name: [Master][Validasi][JRN-01] Manual journal rejects debit and credit on the same line
description: A journal line must be either debit or credit; a balanced journal that washes one account on a single line must be refused.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the general journal (Jurnal Umum) and start a manual journal entry for branch OFFICE MAJU BERSAMA with description 'UJI TestSprite'
Add line 1 on the cash account (Kas) with debit 100 and credit 100
Add line 2 on the same cash account with debit 50 and credit 50
Save the journal
Verify the save is rejected with a message that a line cannot have both debit and credit, and no journal with description 'UJI TestSprite' appears in the journal list

name: [Master][Validasi][PROC-09] Supplier payment above the outstanding payable is refused
description: Paying a supplier more than what is owed must be blocked.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the supplier book (Buku Pemasok & Hutang), open 'UJI Pemasok TestSprite', and note its outstanding payable
Open the supplier payment history (Riwayat Bayar Hutang) and start a new supplier payment for 'UJI Pemasok TestSprite'
Enter an amount equal to the noted outstanding payable plus 500000, choose a cash source account, and branch OFFICE MAJU BERSAMA if asked
Save the payment
Verify the save is rejected with a message that the amount exceeds the outstanding payable

name: [Master][Validasi][PROC-15] Duplicate SKU shows a field error instead of an error page
description: Creating a second product with an SKU already used in the same branch must return a validation message on the form.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the product catalog (Katalog Produk) and start creating a new product
Choose branch GUDANG MAJU BERSAMA, enter name 'UJI SKU Ganda', SKU 'ARF-9627EB33' (already used by BAUT L SOLO), any category, purchase price 1000, and selling price 2000
Save the product
Verify the product form is still shown with a message on the SKU field that it is already used, and no server error page is displayed

name: [Master][Alur kerja][COR-01] A sale with a return still has a usable correction path
description: The correction screen blocks notes that have a return and tells the user to delete the return; that instruction must be actionable.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the sales return history (Retur dari Pelanggan), filter to branch OFFICE MAJU BERSAMA, and open the newest return; note its receipt number
Open the sales report (Riwayat Penjualan), filter to branch OFFICE MAJU BERSAMA, and open the sale with the noted receipt number
Note the message shown about why the sale cannot be edited
Go back to the sales return history and open the same return
Verify the return detail offers a delete or cancel action, matching the instruction shown on the sale

name: [Master][Alur kerja][COR-02] A sale from a closed shift cannot be edited
description: Correcting a sale after its cashier shift was closed would change a reconciled drawer, so it must be refused.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the sales report (Riwayat Penjualan) filtered to branch OFFICE MAJU BERSAMA and today's date
Open the oldest cash sale created by 'UJI Kasir TestSprite' for BAUT L SOLO that has no return
Start editing that sale
Change the quantity of its BAUT L SOLO line from 1 to 2 and save
Verify the edit is refused with a message that the cashier shift is already closed, and the sale's total is unchanged
